source.label: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare: designated cancer care hospitals

method: The prefectural tier of the MHLW list of designated cancer care hospitals (都道府県がん診療連携拠点病院, list as of 令和８年10月１日現在) and the core hospitals of the MHLW list of cancer genomic medicine hospitals (がんゲノム医療中核拠点病院, 令和８年11月１日～), read from the two PDFs linked on the ministry's page. A hospital in both tiers appears twice. Names are the ministry's Japanese names; the English name and website of each come from the hospital's own English pages, checked by hand (src/data/universe-lists/mhlw-english.ts).
